time_of_day: night of 4 Jul to about 09:00 on 6 Jul
rain_note: Heavy downpour from the night of 4 July 2012 to about 09:00 on 6 July 2012
summary: A statement from Saviors and Volunteers for the Environment Sierra Leone (SAVE SL), posted on Facebook on 6 July 2012, says six people died in Freetown during heavy rain from 4 to 6 July 2012: two in a mudslide at New England Ville and four from a rolling boulder at Congo Town. It cites the Sierra Leone Red Cross and environmental groups for the count. Dated 5 July, the middle of the rain, because the deaths are not timed within it.
evidence: "With regards the number of death in Freetown due to heavy down pour of rain that started Wednesday 4th July 2012 at night and ended the 6th July 2012, at around 9:00 A M." ... "the number of death is Six. Two from the New England Ville Community due to mudslide and 4 from Congo Town Community due to boulder rolled." (Facebook group SIERRA LEONE ISSUES, Honourable Koyo posting the SAVE SL message, posted 2012-07-06 17:05 UTC)

rain_note: Continuous heavy rain (mysierraleoneonline.com); "torrential downpour" (Sierra Entertainment Media)
summary: After heavy rain, part of Wallace Johnson Street on the Freetown waterfront collapsed in a landslide at about 22:00 on 8 August 2013, and a second collapse in the early hours of 9 August destroyed King Jimmy Bridge. Reported deaths range from 2 to 15. The BBC reported at least 7 on 9 August and the UK Foreign Office at least 6 on 12 August, so 7 is recorded.
evidence: "The incident happened at around 10.00 pm local time (which is GMT) on Thursday 8 August 2013, as people were leaving mosques following celebrations to mark the end of Ramadan, when part of Wallace Johnson Street on the city's waterfront collapsed." (Facebook, Sciency Thoughts, posted 2013-08-11 16:07 UTC); "landslide that took place last night at King Jimmy along Wallace Johnson Street leaving 2 dead for now as rescuers are still looking for more under the pile of rubble." (Facebook, This Is Sierra Leone, posted 2013-08-09 14:21 UTC); "At least 7 people killed as colonial-era Jimmy Bridge collapses in Sierra Leone capital, Freetown, after heavy rain" (X, @BBCWorld, posted 2013-08-09 17:56 UTC); "the continuous heavy rain has caused a landslide and a bridge collapse at Wallace Johnson Street that has killed two people." (Facebook, mysierraleoneonline.com, posted 2013-08-09 17:26 UTC); "Landslide in Freetown, Sierra Leone kills 6 homeless people." (Facebook, Recent Natural Disasters, posted 2013-08-10 01:54 UTC); "about 10 people lost their lives in the landslide accident due to the torrential downpour of rain in Freetown." (Facebook, Sierra Entertainment Media, posted 2013-08-09); "at least 6 people died when a bridge in Freetown collapsed due to a landslide caused by heavy rain."
